Week 10 research cards

Each model takes the side with the greater expected contest score and selects five distinct games. A cover earns one point and a push earns half a point. These forecasts were issued before the contest deadline. No card was submitted.

ATS records show wins, pushes and losses in that order. Chosen-side records use historical model selections. Intervals are conditional on the fitted model and its historical inputs.

Historical reconstructed cards

Only games eligible at the historical contest deadline enter the comparisons. Matched points use the weeks available to all three policies.

Full 2026 regular season

The binary winner study uses the last public price available to the model one hour before kickoff as scheduled at the time. The table shows its actual lead when the announced start changed. Brier is omitted for ties. Completed game rows show the N102 same-origin model and market where both were recovered. The evidence column identifies earlier releases on uncovered games. Confirmed future rows use N102 probabilities and point forecasts. Original counts cover the N101 recovery study.

Score pairs are away–home. The margin comparison uses HistGB at T−60 when its origin matches. The N102 pooled study uses the vintage market price available to each model. Rows outside this cohort retain the preceding release and identify its comparison timing. Confirmed future win probabilities include a separate tie outcome. Blank fields indicate unavailable or inapplicable evidence.

Upcoming games

Team scores use the N102 sport model, with time-qualified market pooling when available. Win probabilities come from the five-model margin consensus. The source model column distinguishes these two forecast cohorts. Games appear once their kickoff time is confirmed.
